newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Basketball-Shell wins, levels PBA finals at 3-3.
newsitem.headline: Basketball-Shell wins, levels PBA finals at 3-3.

text.p: Formula Shell came back in the dying minutes of their game against Alaska Milkmen to pull off an 88-85 win on Sunday to force a seventh game in the Philippine Basketball Association second conference finals.
Trailing 85-79 with two minutes of play left, Shell scored nine straight points to level the best-of-seven series at three each.

Forward Jolly Escobar scored from under the goal with 40 seconds left to wrest the lead for Shell 86-85 and guard Richie Ticzon sank an improbable, off-balance shot from the corner with 17 seconds remaining to seal the victory.
The final game is scheduled for Tuesday.
